finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Hey, it’s not all bad. In case you’re wondering, the penthouse on top of that huge tower is my home away from home. Maja and Adam also sometimes spend a few days there when I’m really stuck at work, so I can at least pop in occasionally.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “If it’s any consolation, we will be working closely with the authorities. At least some of the time. I’ve come to learn that a lot of the work done by the Court of Shadows relies on walking a tightrope between illegality and remaining too useful to get rid of,” Caleb explained. “That’s why Judges are appointed. We are the ultimate authority in day-to-day matters, our job being to ensure what kind of jobs are taken and that the balance is maintained. If we fail, we also happen to be brilliant fall guys as the Court can point to us as having acted independently or been overly incompetent.”
